title: New Application Ideas of Dynamics 365 Business Central (2026 OCT)
summary: A monthly roundup of community-submitted Business Central improvement ideas from October 2026, grouped by area and credited to each submitter. It covers Copilot, development, financial management, localization and e-invoicing, inventory, sales, and tenant administration.
key_points: Roughly 60 community ideas grouped by functional area, each with the submitter's name
Development requests include dark mode, removing AutoIncrement from a field, and replacement points before IsHandled is restricted
Finance and localization ideas focus on e-invoicing (French rules, ZUGFeRD, EN 16931, E-Document for AT and CH) and on SEPA and ISO 20022 exports
Inventory ideas include consignment inventory by bin, customer-owned inventory, and costing for service-type items
Admin ideas cover Job Queue entry recovery, configurable API throughput, and wider recipient options for credit overage notifications
